mapper.select: SELECT RES.PROC_INST_ID_ ,RES.START_TIME_ ,RES.END_TIME_ ,RES.BUSINESS_STATUS_ ,RES.START_USER_ID_ ,RES.PROC_DEF_ID_, DEF.KEY_ as PROC_DEF_KEY_, DEF.NAME_ as PROC_DEF_NAME_,DEF.VERSION_,TASK.ASSIGNEE_, TASK.NAME_ as TASK_NAME,TASK.TASK_DEF_KEY_,TASK.ID_ as TASK_ID from ACT_HI_TASKINST TASK inner join ACT_HI_PROCINST RES on TASK.PROC_INST_ID_ = RES.PROC_INST_ID_ left join ACT_RE_PROCDEF DEF on RES.PROC_DEF_ID_ = DEF.ID_ left join flow_busi_info bu on bu.process_instance_id = RES.PROC_INST_ID_ ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
